description: This Java interface defines mappings between loan product/payment allocation rules and advanced payment data, using MapStruct for object mapping within the Fineract project.

classes.name: AdvancedPaymentDataMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface for converting loan product and payment allocation rules into AdvancedPaymentData objects.

methods.name: mapLoanProductPaymentAllocationRule
methods.description: Maps a list of LoanProductPaymentAllocationRule objects to a list of AdvancedPaymentData objects.

methods.name: mapLoanPaymentAllocationRule
methods.description: Maps a list of LoanPaymentAllocationRule objects to a list of AdvancedPaymentData objects.

methods.name: mapLoanProductPaymentAllocationRule
methods.description: Maps a single LoanProductPaymentAllocationRule to an AdvancedPaymentData object, including mapping of paymentAllocationOrder.

methods.name: mapLoanPaymentAllocationRule
methods.description: Maps a single LoanPaymentAllocationRule to an AdvancedPaymentData object, including mapping of paymentAllocationOrder.

methods.name: mapAllocationTypes
methods.description: Converts a list of PaymentAllocationType enums into a list of PaymentAllocationOrder objects with associated sequence numbers.
